chunks: If I am unable to express my request, or cannot see my needs, then guide me towards my betterment, and take my heart towards the correct goal, for this is not against (the mode of) Thy guidance nor anything new against Thy ways of support.

key_terms.مَرَاشِدِي: my correct goals or right paths

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when one asks Allah to guide them to their 'masalih' (betterment) because they cannot see their own needs?
ai.summary: This supplication, often cited in Shia devotional literature as a model for *istikhara* (seeking divine guidance), emphasizes reliance on Allah's omniscience when human intellect is limited. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *tawakkul* (trust in God) and the belief that divine direction (*hidayah*) is an inherent attribute of God's mercy, ensuring that the believer's heart is aligned with their ultimate spiritual and worldly welfare.

en.sayed-ali-raza: If I am unable to express my request or cannot see my needs, then guide me towards my betterment and take my heart towards the correct goal, for this is not against (the mode of) Thy guidance nor anything new against Thy ways of support.
